description: Raw per-wallet transfer list (single transactions, not aggregates). Filter by direction (in/out/all), days back, min USD, and optionally a specific token and, for that token, an amount range in whole tokens. Returns time, tx_hash, from, to, token_address, symbol, amount (whole tokens; null when the token's decimals are unknown), value_usd, direction, block. Use when the user asks 'show me recent transfers for X' / 'last 100 transactions of wallet Y' / forensic audit queries.

max_amount.description: Only transfers of at most this many tokens (whole tokens, not raw units, up to 1e18). Needs token_address (an amount across different tokens means nothing) and that token's decimals known, else an error. With min_usd, both must hold. Omit for no ceiling

min_amount.description: Only transfers of at least this many tokens (whole tokens, not raw units, up to 1e18). Needs token_address (an amount across different tokens means nothing) and that token's decimals known, else an error. With min_usd, both must hold. Omit for no floor

min_usd.description: Filter dust below this USD value (default 0)
